title: License details
summary: Priya Raman's Education license on its Status tab: the tier as a control top right that opens Change tier, Limits with each value's source and a per-field Override, a one-year Duration with today marked that keeps the last version, the add-ons it holds, its devices, and the Automatic grant card naming the rule that issued it. The Waiting and Floating holders are in licenses.detail-holders and Change tier in licenses.change-tier.
compare: Header: Licenses › Priya Raman crumbs; 'Priya Raman' with Active; one line of In an account, priya@example.edu and the license id; actions Tier: Education ▾ (opens Change tier), Add key and ⋯. 'Since' is gone: the Duration card starts on that date.
Tabs: Status, Entitlements 6, Keys 0, Devices 3, Activity; on phone the bar scrolls with a fade.
Layout (.mk-with-rail.rail-first): main + 320 rail (400 at wide); below 1280 the rail's two cards come first, side by side; phone one column.

Limits: a table Limit · Value · From with Override per row: Devices 4 (2 from Education, 2 from a seat pack), Offline days 14 marked 'Set on this license / Education gives 7' with Use Education's, Release tracks stable and Versions Any (Platform default), Fingerprint mode Normal (Education) with Open tier. Preview at a date… in the head.
Add-ons: Polaris VPN (polarisVpn), Stem separation (stems), Extra devices (Seat pack of 2), each with where it came from, its term over its start, and ⋯; Comp an add-on… in the head.
Devices: the head's '3 of 4' meter and three rows (name, OS and DJDL version, last seen over first seen, ⋯).
Duration (rail): '1 year, from Education' with Change; the start-to-end line with today marked; 'Then keeps the last version, today 4.2.0'.
Automatic grant (rail): Open Access in the head; the matching rule (Verified email domain example.edu gets Education), with no 'How it works' explainer.
Phone: the Limits rows flow (name, then value and source on one line, the action under them).

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Effective-value provenance is visible on every limit (license, else tier, else platform default)
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Retained-version rights ('then keeps the last version') are visible
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Device and holder semantics are visible (devices count, Automatic grant, holder state)
Round 2 (UX review): The override row ('Set on this license') is an ink bar and wash with the words in strong text, never the Licensing lime (B2).

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: kit rail layout, table, item rows and date span; 0 screen spacing; repeated facts cut.

findings.issue: 35 spacing declarations: custom limit rows, add-on and device rows, a 360px aside grid and a custom date line.

Facts said twice: 'Since Sep 14, 2026' in the header and as Duration's start; 'signed in' on every device; Versions' 'after Sep 14, 2027: the kept version' beside Duration; mechanism lines under Limits and Add-ons.
findings.resolution: Each said once, where it is used.

findings.issue: Right rail ended 475px above the left column at 1920; dead space at wide.
findings.resolution: Page capped at 1400px of content; the rail is sticky (.sticky-1280, top 88px) from 1280. Limits, Add-ons and Devices already share the main column's width; the optional Add-ons and Devices side by side at 1600+ was not built, because the cap leaves the main column at about 970px.

findings.issue: Card header heights differed (66px, 78px); Change sat above the title baseline; Add-ons and Devices used two date styles.
findings.resolution: Every head is .card-head.h56 (56px) with the action on the title's line; Add-ons and Devices show the date alone in muted text (the 'Since' word is gone, its date is the cell's title attribute). The triage both moved and removed Duration's subtitle; it is removed (the tier control shows it).

findings.issue: Duplicated facts and a noisy Automatic grant card.
findings.resolution: Duration subtitle removed; 'today 4.2.0' is '4.2.0'; Automatic grant is the rule line plus Open Access, with the mechanism sentences (moves up only, no key) in an info button's tooltip; the four Override outline buttons are quiet text buttons (.btn.text).

findings.issue: Phone: clipped 'Devices 3' tab with no cue; irregular three-line Limits rows; Add key hidden.
findings.resolution: Tab strip is .tabs.scroller (scroll-snap, 56px edge fade); Limits rows are two lines (.table.two-line: label and bold value, then source and action, 44px targets); Tier and Add key sit as a 50/50 pair (.action-pair).

findings.issue: Remove the 'In an account' pill from the header, and remove the Devices tab count.
findings.resolution: declined: The pill is the holder state, and the tab counts are a kit pattern used on other screens. Removing them here would be inconsistent.

findings.issue: Fold Duration and Automatic grant into one rail card, or move Devices into the rail.
findings.resolution: declined: They are different concepts, so merging them is a structure change. The sticky and capped rail resolves the imbalance.

findings.issue: Reveal Override only on hover or focus.
findings.resolution: declined: Hidden actions hurt discoverability and touch use. A quiet always-visible text button was accepted instead.
